about_the_game:
EMBARK THE "MY LAST 20" (Seconds) MISSION

The company urgently seeks brave astronauts to enlist on the "My Last 20" mission. Your objective: extract as many Space Tokens as possible from the Chaos Zone and survive for a ONLY 20 seconds. This mission posses life insurace in case of death. Are you that brave astronaut?

WHO ARE YOU?

The identity of the person behind the helmet remains a mystery but one thing is certain: sanity is not a quality of you. You are the only one who enlisted willingly to this mission and survived at least twice.

GAMEPLAY

Main Missions: You are required to survive only for 20 seconds and complete various challenges on order to complete the mission and receive the rewards!

Arcade: Fast pace, power-ups, 3 shields and endless time to achieve your best time and show it off to your other astronaut fellas!

And more modes in the future.... like having to destroy a corrupted planet?

KEY FEATURES

  • INCREDIBLY HARD: Being able to complete the My Last 20 mission is not a easy task. 20 seconds sounds like a short time but have to avoid even cows makes it challenging.

  • QUICK GAMEPLAY: Perfect for those who like to test their reflexes and having to react in matter of seconds to avoid being killed by a Space Tentacle.

  • CRAZY LOOKING GRAPHICS: A combination of modern and retro pixel art graphics with unique and weird characters make a perfect combination for a real trip. 

  • MULTIPLE CHALLENGES: Play the main missions, complete hard challenges or play endlessly without time limitations and score your best time.
